members.notes: CCEL ThML XML covers volumes 1, 2, and 9. Permission for use confirmed with CCEL (Quincy) on 2026-04-01.

cross_source_readings.notes: Two parsers ingest the same encyclopedia from independent OCR pipelines. The OCR scanner producer treats CCEL-vs-IA disagreements as a witness-equivalent signal (Phase A4).
